speaker: abel_garnish
text: The third entrance. You are a line early, Master Will. The father is not on yet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then hold me. I would rather come late than come in on the wrong word.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A line early is a kindness to a cold yard. You may have it back, if you mean to be strict.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I mean to be strict. The laugh you already own is yours. My entrance is not.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou art right to hold it. A man who comes in early spends the room before he has said anything.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The strain under that entrance is eight bars. We have been giving it four, and then the old man trips on the short of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Eight, then. Augustine, give him the eight. I will not enter on the four.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Eight bars, and a line later. I will mark the plot for two of the clock. I will not rewrite the book for one morning.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Two of the clock is the Shrew, and the yard will not count your bars. The yard counts whether I am any good.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The yard counted you yesterday. Leave his door where Garnish has set it, and do not improve a play we already know.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: What I play at two is the old man with the message. I am not writing him a name in the margin. He comes, he speaks, he goes.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Then he needs no song, and I will not make him one. A new song is a new labour, and this play is not new.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Good. I have no clean paper owed to a new song, and I will not prompt a father off a blot.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is no blot. There is a line I took too soon. That is the whole of the fault.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You are early in your head all this Christmas, whether or not you are early in the door. It suits paper. It does not suit my plot.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou wilt be on the second father at two, Will, or thou wilt hear me across the yard.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will be on it. Thou needst not threaten a man who has already agreed.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Again from the third entrance, and save the breath. The first line is not the whole scene.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: From father, and not from the father in the line above. That is why you were early. Two fathers, and only one of them is yours.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two fathers. Mine is the second. I have it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Two fathers and one clown is enough crowd. Do not put in a third father to be safe.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: No third. At two I want him already in the door when I come to be angry, not still arriving.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He will be in the door. Eight bars, and the second father. That is as much rehearsal as a known play wants.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Enough, if the boys have eaten before two. Sam ate. I asked him.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Sam is not in this entrance. Do not feed him into the margin. The third entrance is Master Will, a line later than he took it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A line later. I will take that. Kemp, the laugh is yours when I am in, and not before.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I can wait a line. I cannot wait a sermon before dinner. Be an old man at two, and leave the rest of us our pace.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Come, then. Thou hast the second father. I have a house to be angry in, and I want my dinner first.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am with you. Two of the clock, and not a line early.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Eight bars. You shall have all eight. Do not enter on the fourth, even if the yard coughs.
